plan.notes: Source: 'B.S. in C.S - Artificial Intelligence Track' semester-by-semester sheet (22 courses, 76 credits, 4 years), Yeshiva College Academic Advising Center, yu.edu, July 2025, issued under the Yeshiva College Undergraduate Catalog for Men 2024-2026 (addendum 12.05.25). Source URL: https://www.yu.edu/sites/default/files/inline-files/Comp%20Sci%20%20AI%20July%202025.pdf. Transcription method: manual transcription of the official PDF; no courses, credits, or prereqs invented. True degree name per the official catalog: 'Computer Science, BS', offered in two concentrations: Artificial Intelligence (this plan) and Distributed Systems (separate official sheet, 'Comp Sci DS July 2025'). The official sheet publishes no prerequisite information, so all prereq lists are empty. The 8 YC Core slots follow the sheet's one-per-semester placement; their mapping to the sheet's 8 published non-C.S. requirements (22 credits: First Year Writing 3; BIB/JHI/JST/JTP 2+2; COWC/CUOT 3; INTC 3; HBSI 3; two YC-department electives 3+3) follows the order of the sheet's requirements table, since the sheet itself only numbers the slots #1-#8. Credit math: 76 (AI track) + 22 (YC Core) + 30 (elective/shiur) = 128, the catalog's published degree minimum ('All students need a total of 128 credits to graduate'). Students entering with 32 YU Israel-program credits need only the 8 YC Core courses beyond the major (32+76+22=130 >= 128) and are advised to take one YC Core per semester. The degree additionally requires no fewer than 8 full-time terms including 8 terms of UTS (morning program); UTS carries no credit value in the sheet and is not modeled. Caveat: the catalog addendum text labels the AI concentration '75 credits' while the July 2025 sheet's own course list sums to 76; the sheet's arithmetic is used here.
